dialogue.content: こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら、始めさせて頂きたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for being here today. I'd like to begin, as our session time has started.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。ご相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。始めに、年齢、性別、相談内容を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming to consult with us. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and the nature of your concern?

dialogue.content: 20歳女母が嫌いです
dialogue.English: I'm a 20-year-old woman, and I hate my mother.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お母さんの事が嫌いというお話なのですね
dialogue.English: Thank you. So you're here to talk about disliking your mother.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのような事でもお聴きいたしますのでお話しできる範囲で大丈夫ですのでお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: I'm here to listen to whatever you'd like to share, so please feel free to tell me whatever you're comfortable with.

dialogue.content: 鬱陶しくて価値観の押し付けが
dialogue.English: She’s overbearing and forces her values on me.

dialogue.content: あと嫉妬深い
dialogue.English: Also, she's very jealous.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。価値観を押し付けられるとなんだか嫌になってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Having someone impose their values on you can feel really unpleasant.

dialogue.content: 嫉妬深い言うのはどのような事でそう感じらるのですか？
dialogue.English: When you say she’s jealous, what kinds of situations make you feel that way?

dialogue.content: はい嫌いです
dialogue.English: Yes, I hate it.

dialogue.content: そう思われているのですね
dialogue.English: I understand that's how you feel.

dialogue.content: 嫉妬深いのは私が他の人を頼ると怒ります
dialogue.English: Regarding her jealousy, she gets angry when I rely on other people.

dialogue.content: 誰かに頼るということは悪いことでは無いのに、戸惑ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Relying on someone isn't a bad thing at all, so that must be very confusing for you.

dialogue.content: 例えばどのような事があった時ですか？
dialogue.English: For example, when has that happened?

dialogue.content: 家でご飯を食べるのが嫌で友人の家でしょっちゅうご飯を食べて帰るんですがその友達の悪口を言いだしたり、、
dialogue.English: I don’t like eating at home, so I often have dinner at a friend’s place, but then she starts badmouthing that friend...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 好きな人ができても悪口を言って離そうとします
dialogue.English: Even when I'm dating someone, she'll say bad things about them and try to separate us.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。あなたにとって大切な人達の悪口を言われるのは少し困ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be very upsetting to hear her speak ill of the people who are important to you.

dialogue.content: 嫌悪感ですね
dialogue.English: It makes me feel disgusted.

dialogue.content: それは嫌になってしまうというのも仕方ないのかも知れませんね…
dialogue.English: It might be understandable that you've come to dislike her then...

dialogue.content: お母様はあなたの事が心配で仕方が無いように感じましたがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: It sounds to me as if your mother might be incredibly worried about you. Does that resonate with you?

dialogue.content: もう家を出たいんですがそのことをいうと怒ったり、泣いたり
dialogue.English: I want to move out, but when I mention it, she gets angry or starts crying.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 心配ではないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think it’s worry.

dialogue.content: 独占欲
dialogue.English: It’s possessiveness.

dialogue.content: そう思われているのですね
dialogue.English: That’s how you see it.

dialogue.content: はい疲れます
dialogue.English: Yes, it’s exhausting.

dialogue.content: 縛られているような気がして疲れますよね。ちなみにご家族は何人ですか？
dialogue.English: It must be exhausting to feel so tied down. By the way, how many people are in your family?

dialogue.content: 四人です
dialogue.English: There are four of us.

dialogue.content: 四人という事ですが、ご両親とご兄弟ですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned there are four of you. Is that your parents and a sibling?

dialogue.content: はい妹がいます
dialogue.English: Yes, I have a younger sister.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。妹さんはどのように言っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What does your younger sister say about this?

dialogue.content: 付き合っていくのは大変だと
dialogue.English: She says it’s hard to deal with her.

dialogue.content: なるほど妹さんもそのように思われているのですね…
dialogue.English: I see, so your sister feels the same way...

dialogue.content: でも私ほどは嫌いじゃないみたいです
dialogue.English: But she doesn’t seem to dislike her as much as I do.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。あなたはもう成人しているのでお母様にいろいろプレッシャーを掛けられると辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Now that you're an adult, it must be very difficult for you when your mother puts all this pressure on you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつぐらいからお母様の事をそのように感じるようになったのですか？？
dialogue.English: Around when did you start to feel this way about your mother?

dialogue.content: 小さい時から、うちの家は暗いなと母がすぐメソメソ泣くので友達の家に入り浸ってました
dialogue.English: Since I was little, our home felt gloomy. My mother would whimper and cry easily, so I practically lived at my friends’ houses.

dialogue.content: 明るいお母さんの家が羨ましくて
dialogue.English: I was envious of homes with cheerful mothers.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 中学くらいからほとんど帰らなくなりました
dialogue.English: From around middle school, I hardly went home.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは小さい時からそのようなお母様を見ていて、辛かったのではないかと感じてしまいましたがいかがですか？
dialogue.English: It seems to me that seeing your mother like that since you were little must have been very painful for you. Is that how it was?

dialogue.content: はい辛かったです
dialogue.English: Yes, it was painful.

dialogue.content: そう思われていたのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand that's how you felt.

dialogue.content: はいでも私が帰らなくなって妹が一人で母の相手をして鬱になりましたなので帰ってきました
dialogue.English: Yes, but after I stopped coming home, my younger sister had to deal with our mother by herself and became depressed, so I came back home.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。妹さんもお母様もあなたもみんな頑張っていらしたのですね…
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like your sister, your mother, and you have all been trying very hard...

dialogue.content: 妹には悪かったとなので簡単に家をでれなくて
dialogue.English: I felt bad for my sister, so now I can't just leave home so easily.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。妹さんの事を思いやる優しいお気持ちが伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: I see. I can really feel your kindness and concern for your sister.

dialogue.content: 優しいかはわかりませんが悪かったとは思ってます
dialogue.English: I don't know if I'm kind, but I do feel that what I did was wrong.

dialogue.content: 悪かったというのはどのような事でそう思われているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say you feel it was wrong, what do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: 母を押し付けた
dialogue.English: I burdened her with our mother.

dialogue.content: あなたも嫌だと思っているお母様を妹さんに任せてしまい、妹さんが鬱になってしまったことを悔やんでいるのかと思いましたがいかがでしょうか。？
dialogue.English: It sounds like you regret leaving your sister alone to deal with a mother you yourself find difficult, especially since your sister became depressed. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はいそうですね悔やんでますあの子の人生が大きく狂ったので
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right. I regret it, because her life was thrown far off course.

dialogue.content: そう思われるとお辛いですよね…
dialogue.English: That must be a very painful thought to carry...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたもお母様から離れたいと思っていたことは、悪いことでは無いのではないかと思いました。
dialogue.English: I want to say that wanting to get away from your mother was not a bad thing.

dialogue.content: 小さな時からお母様に振り回されていたのかなと…
dialogue.English: It sounds like you may have been at your mother’s mercy from a young age...

dialogue.content: 離れないと私もおかしくなっていたと思います
dialogue.English: If I hadn't gotten away, I think I would have lost my mind too.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。あなたはご自分の事を守ったのですから
dialogue.English: That makes sense. You were protecting yourself, after all.

dialogue.content: そうですねあの時はそうするしかなかったです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. At the time, I felt it was the only choice I had.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: お父様は何もいわれないのですか？
dialogue.English: Does your father not say anything about it?

dialogue.content: 父は仕事で単身赴任で、、でももともと無口で話しません
dialogue.English: My father is living away from home for work... but he's always been quiet and doesn't talk much anyway.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…お二人でずっとお母様の事を耐えていらしたのですね
dialogue.English: I see... So it's been the two of you enduring your mother this whole time.

dialogue.content: ちなみに妹さんはおいくつですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, how old is your sister?

dialogue.content: 16歳です。中学くらいから鬱になりました
dialogue.English: She's 16. Her depression started around the time she was in junior high.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今、帰ってこられたことは妹さんにとって、とても心強い感じおもっているのかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: Your sister might feel very relieved and supported by the fact that you've come back home.

dialogue.content: どうでしょうか心の底では怒ってるかもしれません
dialogue.English: I'm not so sure. Deep down, she might be angry at me.

dialogue.content: 一人にした事を
dialogue.English: For leaving her alone.

dialogue.content: そう思うということ、家を出たご自分のこと後悔されているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Feeling that way, do you regret having left home?

dialogue.content: 後悔というか、、私が逃げたい一心で残された妹のことを何も気にしていなかったことは申し訳なかったなと
dialogue.English: I don’t know if it’s regret exactly, but I feel sorry that, in my desperation to escape, I didn’t think at all about the sister I was leaving behind.

dialogue.content: それは自然な事だと思いました。あなたはご自分を保つための手段がそれしか無かったのではないかと思いました。
dialogue.English: I think that's a very natural reaction. It seems like it was the only way you could protect your own well-being.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: とても妹さん思いのお姉さんだと感じました。
dialogue.English: I sense that you’re a very caring older sister.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes, I do.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お一人で悩まず、またこちらにお話に来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please don't hesitate to come back and talk again instead of worrying about this alone.

dialogue.content: はいまた聴いてください
dialogue.English: Yes, please listen to me again.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたので終了となりますが、よろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is up for today. Shall we conclude the session?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: That’s fine.

dialogue.content: あなたの事を応援していますね。それでは失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: I'm rooting for you. Take care.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。ご指導よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. I look forward to your feedback.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well.)

dialogue.content: （では終了します。失礼いたします。）
dialogue.English: (Okay, I will end the session now. Goodbye.)
